messages:
Theo Kim: Morning team  Theo here, first day as an AE. Quick blocker: I can't access the AE Rapid-Start playbook and HubSpot/Gong aren't visible in my SSO app list. Who handles seats and the canonical quick-start?

Ops IT: Welcome Theo! Please open a provisioning ticket (or paste the snippet below into portal) so we can track it:
```
product: Sales tools
requester: Theo Kim
email: theo.kim@redwood.example
access: HubSpot (Full seat), Gong (seat), Drive: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Rapid-Start-2025
priority: standard
needed-by: 2024-08-20
```
Reply with the ticket ID and I'll triage immediately.

Theo Kim: Raised REQ-8120. Thanks. My shadow is tomorrow afternoon so would love a fast turnaround.

Riley (sales-ops): Hey Theo  welcome! Canonical quick-start is the AE Rapid-Start pack in Drive. Short items: "Discovery 7Qs", "Deal Qualification Rubric", and a 12-min Gong calibration recording. I can add you to the Drive once Ops confirms seat assignment.

Priya (CS): For handoffs, use the CS Handoff template in Playbooks/Templates. If you want practice, I can create a sandbox lead and pre-fill it with a fake case to run through the flow after you get HubSpot.

Ops IT: REQ-8120 status: provisioning in progress. Quick heads up: we are currently at the HubSpot license cap for that pool. Two options: 1) temporary observer HubSpot access + Playbook PDF bundle, or 2) escalate seat from reserve (takes ~EOD). Which do you prefer?

Theo Kim: Observer + PDF bundle would be fine to start if that gets me shadow-ready. If seat frees up later, great.

Sam (enablement): I'll drop a mini onboarding pack into Drive and pin the 7-question cheat to you. Also I run a 20-min "First Calls" sync that covers the call rubric and 3 objection scripts  want to join after your shadow?

Riley (sales-ops): Ops IT  if reserve is tight, please push observer + PDF bundle. I'll spin up an "AE-Shadow" sequence in HubSpot that Theo can view as observer; we'll clone to edit later.

Ops IT: Done: uploaded AE_RapidStart_bundle_READER.zip to your Drive and granted HubSpot observer invite (theo.kim@redwood.example). Gong invite pending until seat freed. REQ-8120 updated with links.

onboard-bot: Welcome Theo Kim! Onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/checklists/theo_kim_1749004567. Tasks added: Accept HubSpot observer invite, Review RapidStart bundle, Join shadow, Watch Gong calibration (when available).

Theo Kim: Got the PDF bundle and the HubSpot observer invite. Can see records but can't clone sequences  that's fine for tomorrow's shadow. Thanks for the fast workaround.

Priya (CS): Sandbox lead created: "AE Sandbox - Theo" and I added sample tasks: log call, add note, create CS handoff. When Gong is available we can review the auto-tagging rubric together.

Sam (enablement): Cool  I added you to the "First Calls" 20-min sync right after your shadow. We'll roleplay the first 6 minutes and practice the objection scripts. Bring any questions about the rubric.

Riley (sales-ops): Follow-up: tracking EOD to see if we can free a Gong seat. If not, replay the Gong calibration recording in the bundle and we'll do a live calibration later.

Theo Kim: Appreciate it all  joining the shadow tomorrow and will review the bundle tonight. :rocket:
